heading.title: First Division · Part II · Suits Relating to Contracts

article.title: Three years.
article.content:
Article11Three years.

The Schedule  ·  First Division—Suits · Part II—Suits Relating to Contracts
Against a carrier for compensation for non-delivery of, or delay in delivering, goods.
Period of limitationThree years.

Time from which period begins to runWhen the goods ought to be delivered.
